questions.q: The post-planting operation that involves covering the soil surface with dry grass, leaves, or plastic films to conserve soil moisture and suppress weeds is called ________.
questions.explain: Mulching is the agricultural practice of covering the topsoil with materials (like dry grass or wood shavings) to reduce evaporation, conserve moisture, and prevent weed growth.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Why do farmers apply fertilizers and manures to their crops during the growing season?
options: To attract beneficial insect pests to the farm
To artificially increase the amount of rainfall
To replenish lost soil nutrients and improve crop yield
questions.explain: Manuring and fertilizer application add essential mineral nutrients back to the soil, which are absorbed by crop roots to promote vigorous growth and high yields.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The final stage of crop cultivation in the field, which involves gathering or picking the mature farm produce, is referred to as ________.
questions.explain: Harvesting is the act of removing or gathering mature crops from the field for consumption, processing, or storage.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a major negative effect of late harvesting of crops?
options: The crops become overly resistant to diseases
The crops gain maximum market value
It leads to field losses from over-ripening, rotting, and pest attacks
It causes the soil to lose all its moisture immediately
questions.explain: Delayed or late harvesting exposes the mature crops to rodents, birds, insect pests, and severe weather conditions, often leading to shattering, rotting, and a massive drop in yield and quality.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The post-harvest operation that involves converting raw farm produce into more usable, edible, and easily storable forms is known as ________.
questions.explain: Processing alters the physical or chemical state of harvested crops to make them usable or improve their shelf-life (e.g., turning raw cassava tubers into garri).
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: After harvesting and processing, keeping agricultural produce safe from spoilage, pests, and theft for future use or sale is termed ________.
questions.explain: Storage is the post-harvest operation designed to hold agricultural products safely over a period of time to maintain their quality until they are needed.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies
